sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir & Eleanor Ridge. 2025. VanBib: A database of references to resources on Vanuatu languages, v1.3. Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.17628152
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliographic check: the 13 entries tagged wusi1237 are all wordlists (Tryon 1976, ABVD, ASJP, kava/taro/food-plant name lists 1988/1998/2004, Vanuatu Voices 2025) or overviews (Tryon 2010); no grammar, sketch or phonology is recorded for the language.

sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir. 2026 (in press). The phonological history of 17 varieties in western Espiritu Santo (Vanuatu). Language and Linguistics in Melanesia (vol. 44?).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: First phonological treatment ever of Wusi (09_Wusi_Kula) and Kerepua (08_Kerepua_Tuijo); may contain synchronic inventories and a prosody remark. Supplementary data already posted 2026-09-15; article not yet on langlxmelanesia.com as of 2026-09-17 (open access when it appears).

sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir. 2026. Supplementary materials to 'The phonological history of 17 varieties in western Espiritu Santo (Vanuatu)', Language and Linguistics in Melanesia. Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.22762181 (methods PDF + ODS lexical dataset incl. columns 08_Kerepua_Tuijo, 09_Wusi_Kula).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; 'relatively broad IPA transcription.. Other finer phonetic detail has generally been ignored'; only 4 stress marks in 8615 datapoints, none in the Wusi/Kerepua columns. The article itself is not yet online (LLM vol. 44 page checked).

sources.citation: Takau, Lana et al. 2025. Vanuatu Voices v1.4, doculects Wusi (Kula), Kerepua (Tuijo), Elia: audio wordlists (282 items each).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Open audio for every item; stress could be determined instrumentally; transcriptions downloaded now carry no stress marks.

sources.citation: Takau, Lana et al. 2025. Vanuatu Voices v1.4: Wordlist for Wusi (language Kula), 282 items with audio. Leipzig: MPI-EVA. doi:10.5281/zenodo.17407434; https://vanuatuvoices.clld.org/contributions/Wusi
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No statement; IPA transcriptions carry no stress marks (vowel length is marked, often on the penult, e.g. liːma 'five', βaːti 'four', raptoːlu 'eight', but that is data, not a description). Audio is open and would permit a first-hand determination.

sources.citation: Taman, Allan, Sabrina Taman & Tihomir Rangelov. 2025. Language ecosystems in Western Santo. Te Reo 68(2): 186-245 (special issue 'Vanuatu languages in context'). doi:10.5281/zenodo.18723279
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; sociolinguistic/vitality survey with a section on Tuijo/Kula (wusi1237, ~401 L1 speakers); states 'Linguistic data from this part of Vanuatu are scarce' and that the language lacks literacy materials and a writing system.

sources.citation: Tryon, Darrell. 2010. The languages of Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu. In Bowden, Himmelmann & Ross (eds), A journey through Austronesian and Papuan linguistic and cultural space: papers in honour of Andrew K. Pawley, 283-290. Pacific Linguistics 615.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; lists '7. Kula: Wusi, Kerepua, Elia 1 [350]' with village/speaker info only.

sources.citation: Clark, Ross. 2009. *Leo Tuai: A comparative lexical study of North and Central Vanuatu languages. Pacific Linguistics 603.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL6211.V36 C59 2009
sources.note: Gives stress notes only for its principal witness languages (Nokuku, Kiai, Tamabo, Araki, Raga etc.); Wusi appears only as cited forms in cognate sets; no Wusi stress statement. General remark that PNCV stress was probably penultimate (sec. 2.1.3).

sources.citation: Lynch, John & Terry Crowley. 2001. Languages of Vanuatu: a new survey and bibliography. Pacific Linguistics 517. Canberra: ANU. Sec. 3.3.8 'Wusi', p. 51.

sources.harvard_location: Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL6211.V36 L96 2001
sources.note: Nothing; states 'The only other published information from this language apart from these wordlists [Tryon 1976] are several names for kava varieties'; summary table rates Wusi grammar 0, dictionary no, texts no.

sources.citation: Tryon, Darrell T. 1976. New Hebrides languages: an internal classification. Pacific Linguistics C-50. Canberra: ANU.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.note: Nothing for Wusi: wordlists (38 Wusi I, 39 Wusi II, 40 Kerepua, 45 Nonona) and sound-correspondence tables only; no per-language prosody; the words 'penultimate'/'accent' do not occur in the volume.
